95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.

Get out of my sight!

98340-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
98340-accept.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young $c. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340-accept.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98404-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-complete.text:
Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $c.
98404-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-progress.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-progress.text: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404-progress.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
